turns.text: how do I link a care context to a patient's ABHA
First generate a link token for the patient with POST /api/hiecm/v3/token/generate-token. The token arrives on your bridge at /api/v3/hip/token/on-generate-token, and you then link with it.
how do i know which patient's request that callback is for

must_contain: Match the callback to your request by response.requestId, which echoes the REQUEST-ID you sent on the generate token call.
Store that REQUEST-ID before you send the call, so a fast callback still finds a match.
notes: The last turn is under specified: 'that callback' is on-generate-token from the assistant turn.
